description: PromptQL (by Hasura) is an AI data agent for enterprises. Business and data users ask questions in plain English; PromptQL writes an explicit query plan over the company's databases, warehouses and APIs, runs it deterministically, and shows every step, so answers are accurate and auditable instead of LLM guesses.
features: natural-language questions over Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and SaaS APIs
explicit, reviewable query plans instead of free-form SQL generation
row- and column-level access control inherited from Hasura's data layer
semantic layer that learns company definitions and metrics
constraints: sold to companies with a real data stack (a warehouse and a data team)
enterprise sales motion; North America and Europe first
customers: data and analytics teams already using Hasura for their GraphQL data layer
pricing: enterprise contracts, priced per deployment; contact sales
